researcher_notes: Per-segment length 185.00 km NOT independently verifiable. MEED is the only source giving route-level lengths and reports EWPS-4 to EWPS-6 as 370km combined (lines 3 & 4) for the COMBINED package (both parallel lines 3 & 4 together); GEM splits each package into separate single-line rows, so the per-line figure appears in no source and is not cleanly half the package total either. Existing MEED ref re-verified live but does NOT contain 185.00 (verifier: value-not-found). Length left unverified; needs Aramco package-level documentation.

Diameter 56 in: MEED explicitly tabulates every MGS-3 east-west package (incl. EWPS-4-6, EWPS-6-8, EWPS-8-10) as '56-inch'; JPT (SPE) corroborates 56-inch pipe. MEED ref re-verified live and contains the value.

Location=Saudi Arabia (both endpoints): the MGS east-west system lies entirely within Saudi Arabia; MEED names the EWPS pump-station endpoints and JPT (SPE) confirms the kingdom-wide MGS network. Ref was blank; two independent live sources added.

Owner1=Aramco 100%: Saudi Aramco owns/operates the Master Gas System; MEED and JPT (SPE) both attribute MGS-3 to Aramco. One existing ref (aramco.com) ReadTimeout/unreachable on verifier; anchored with two live independent sources. operators_owners tab.

FuelSource=Natural Gas: MGS-3 transports non-associated/unconventional natural gas (incl. Jafurah feed) per JPT (SPE) and Pipeline Technology Journal; MEED also describes the natural-gas Master Gas System. Filled blank FuelSource.

Capacity NOT filled (best-effort). Sources report only a SYSTEM-WIDE figure: MGS-3 adds ~3.15 bscfd across ~4,000 km of new pipe by 2028 (JPT/PTJ). No per-segment/per-line throughput is published for the individual EWPS spools and the system figure cannot be apportioned to one line without fabrication. Left blank per best-effort-on-gas-capacity guidance.

Segment EXISTS and is correctly attributed to MGS-3 -- MEED tabulates the EWPS-4 to EWPS-6 56-inch package and explicitly says Aramco is laying 'east-west gas pipelines three and four' (matching GEM's '3'/'4' line suffix). NOT a duplicate/non-existent flag. CAVEAT for human review: GEM models each MEED package as two single-line rows, but the GEM per-line length (185.00 km) does not reconcile with MEED's combined package length (370km combined (lines 3 & 4)) -- not 2x-consistent. Recommend verifying the per-segment length split against Aramco package documentation; values not overwritten.
